versions.changelog: v1.3.0: Added 'resume' command to reconnect to kept-alive runtimes (skips VM assignment, reuses installed packages and /tmp files). 'stop' without args stops saved runtime. State saved to ~/.colab-runtime-state.json. Note: Python variable state does not persist across reconnections — use file checkpoints.

v1.2.0: Codex review fixes — trap-based cleanup in inject_and_run.sh (token leak on crash), auto-bootstrap venv on first run, added drive.file to colab_drive.py SCOPES, list/download no longer create folders as side effect.

v1.1.0: Bundle all executable scripts (colab_run.py, colab_tts.py, colab_drive.py, inject_and_run.sh, reauth_with_drive.py). Sanitized voice ID from TTS help text. Updated SKILL.md to reference bundled scripts/ path.
Initial release: headless Colab API, GPU assignment (T4/L4/A100/H100), Google Drive persistence, F5-TTS voice synthesis, structured output parsing.
